offering_description.value: Flowserve designs and manufactures pumps, mechanical seals, valves, and related controls for industrial plants, utilities, and engineering contractors. It supplies equipment for new facilities and supports installed equipment through field service and regional repair centers.

primary_products.value: engineered and industrial pumps; mechanical seals and seal support systems; industrial valves; valve actuators and controls; replacement parts

primary_services.value: equipment repair and overhaul; field maintenance; installation and commissioning; equipment upgrades and retrofits; condition monitoring

customer_segment.value: B2B: Oil and gas operators, chemical producers, power generators, industrial manufacturers, and engineering and construction contractors; B2G: Municipal water and wastewater utilities

end_markets.value: oil and gas; chemicals and petrochemicals; power generation; water and wastewater; general industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: New pumps, seals, valves, actuators, controls, and replacement parts; service fees: Field maintenance, equipment diagnostics, repair, and overhaul; project or contract: Engineered equipment packages for capital projects, equipment retrofits, and ongoing maintenance agreements
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns castings, metals, and purchased components into flow control equipment for plant operators and engineering contractors; service provider: Repairs and upgrades installed flow equipment for industrial plant operators and utilities

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Industrial pumps, mechanical seals, valves, actuation and controls, and aftermarket services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales engineers and account teams serving plant operators and engineering contractors; distributors / dealers: Industrial equipment distributors supplying pumps, valves, seals, and parts; own locations: Company-operated service centers supplying local parts, repairs, and equipment upgrades
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Manufacturing faces OSHA and environmental rules, and equipment for nuclear plants faces nuclear quality requirements.
